messages:
ajay: heads-up — nebula-7b int8 bring-up: macrotask eval shows a weird locale gap. JP BLEU down ~2.3, KO chrF down ~3.1 vs fp16. not expected.
lee: ugh, when did we flip the quant kernels? was this the nightly bundle from 03/12?
ajay: yes, build 2025-03-12 02:10 (auto-quant int8 schedule). running the standard hush-eval bench: 5k dev samples across en->{ja,ko,zh,ar}.
maria: can you paste the exact command you ran? will repro locally.
ajay: command: ```bash
run_eval --model nebula-7b --variant int8 --task translation --split dev --langs ja,ko,zh,ar --samples 5000 --tokenizer default
```
yun: did you also try the int8 path with the old tokenizer mapping? we had a tokenizer mapping tweak last month that changed ZWJ handling.
ajay: good call — i ran only with default mapping. i can rerun with `--tokenizer mapping:v1` in a minute.
sarah: quick sanity: are we sure it's model-only and not batch config? int8 path changed KV cache layout in the runtime, might affect chunked decoding on vertical japanese lines.
ajay: noted — i observed most diffs on samples with vertical markers and newline-heavy samples (subtitles, OCR outputs).
lee: share an example where it diverges.
ajay: sample pair (gold -> pred):
---
gold: 今日もよろしくお願いします。
fp16 pred: 今日もよろしくお願いします。
int8 pred: 今日もお願いいたします。
---
small but BLEU-sensitive because honorifics and verb nuance.
maria: hmm that example looks like a surface-level lexical swap, could be detokenization mismatch rather than generation. what's the tokenization sequence lengths?
ajay: fp16 token ids (short): [234, 10234, 405, 99]
int8 token ids (short): [234, 10234, 406, 99]
yun: id off-by-one in the tokenizer map for the 3rd token? that smells like a different subword merge.
sarah: also check grapheme splitting for hangul jamo. we saw earlier a preprocessing step that normalized jamo cluster boundaries for fp16 path only. maybe quant path skipped normalization?
lee: can you post the eval diff summary? per-lang metrics and a few failure cases are enough.
ajay: pasted run summary:
---
lang: ja  BLEU fp16 28.7 -> int8 26.4  (delta -2.3)
lang: ko  chrF fp16 52.1 -> int8 49.0 (delta -3.1)
lang: zh  BLEU fp16 31.0 -> int8 30.8 (delta -0.2)
lang: ar  BLEU fp16 27.4 -> int8 27.2 (delta -0.2)
---
plus a list of ~120 regression examples (uploading to s3: s3://redwood-evals/nebula/int8/1767801234/regressions.jsonl)
maria: ok upload looks good. i skimmed — many ja regressions have ZWJ/ideographic space weirdness, ko ones are often jamo split/merge. this feels tokenization/detok, not core LM outputs.
yun: to isolate: run a test where we decode the same fp16 logits through the int8 detok pipeline (and vice versa). if detok/tokenizer mapping differs we'll reproduce the shift.
lee: also re-run with `--disable-prefix-cache` in case KV cache path is introducing different attention offsets for left-context heavy samples.
ajay: scheduled two reruns now: (1) rerun tokenizer mapping v1, (2) rerun with disable-prefix-cache, (3) re-decode saved fp16 logits through int8 detok. starting now. ETA ~6m per job.
ops-bot: queued 3 jobs: nebula-int8-tokenmap-check (id q-3421), nebula-int8-noprefix (id q-3422), nebula-redecode (id q-3423). estimated completion 12:40 UTC.
lee: if those confirm it's detok, we should patch the quant bring-up checklist: add tokenizer map parity check + detok smoke before rollout.
sarah: agree. also add a small bilingual sample set with vertical/newline heavy lines and jamo-edge cases to the canary suite.
yun: FYI i found a small code diff in tokenizer mapping table: commit 9f4a7a changed `` handling and inadvertently shifted following ids by 1 for the legacy subword table used in quant conversion. i'll open PR to revert mapping and add unit tests.
maria: nice catch. once PR is up, can we run a quick AB on the 120 regression samples to confirm fixes before we touch kernels?
ajay: will run AB once PR lands. for now tagging this thread for visibility: @eng-ml @eng-runtime. thanks all, will update with job outputs. :eyes:
